items.title: Here's what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: ECB seeks industry partners for tokenized deposits, securities experiments
items.summary: Industry groups have until Dec. 11 to apply for the ECB's first experimental exercises under its Appia initiative, with later submissions reviewed on a rolling basis.

items.title: US lawmakers propose up to 30% rewards for prediction market whistleblowers
items.summary: Whistleblowers could receive 10% to 30% of monetary sanctions in qualifying prediction market fraud cases exceeding $1 million in penalties.

items.title: Hong Kong pushes to bring crypto custodians, advisers under licensing rules
items.summary: Hong Kong's securities regulator says the proposal would strengthen investor protections, with the bill set for its first reading in the Legislative Council on Dec. 2.

items.title: Wrapped Monero token crashes 99.8% amid suspected $13.5M exploit
items.summary: Bitquery traced $13.5 million in suspicious sales of the wrapped Monero token, as its operator blamed a security breach and promised to reimburse affected traders.

items.title: Sky Protocol sees $2 billion in stablecoin withdrawals, disputes illicit fund claims
items.summary: Sky says its USDS stablecoin held its $1 value despite more than $2 billion in withdrawals, as it disputes a report linking the protocol to illicit activity.

items.title: GTA 6 Leaker Dangles a PC Port Behind a $15 Million Crypto Pump
items.summary: The anonymous leaker, Cyberleek, released a 209 GB Xbox build but is withholding the executable that could enable a PC port until its CYBERLEEK token hits $15 million.

items.title: Fraudsters Used Fake Crypto Exchanges to Steal $37 Million, SEC Alleges
items.summary: The agency says eight Colorado-registered entities, likely run from overseas, posed as legitimate advisers and crypto platforms-even faking SEC certificates and filings-to defraud U.S. investors of more than $37 million.

items.title: Signal Calls OS-Level AI an 'Existential Threat' and Blocks Screenshots to Fight It
items.summary: The encrypted-messaging app will restrict screenshots on iOS 27 and auto-enable screen security on Android when it detects an AI assistant reading a chat.

items.title: Is the AI Bubble Finally Popping? Nvidia Crashes 48% as Wall Street Experts Sound the Alarm
items.summary: Tech stocks are buckling after Anthropic's historic IPO and Nvidia's leadership crisis, while Bitcoin has slipped below $60,000. Experts disagree on whether AI faces a correction or a dot-com-style bust.

items.title: Claude Claims Historic Math Breakthrough One Day After Anthropic IPO
items.summary: Levent Alpoge claims Claude helped prove a 167-year-old math conjecture, but independent checks remain pending, and the release just after Anthropic's IPO has prompted questions about its unusual publication timing.

items.title: Nvidia Shares Sink to 52-Week Low After Report SEC Is Probing Accounting
items.summary: Nvidia shares fell about 13% to a 52-week low after reports that SEC enforcement staff are examining potential accounting issues, adding to pressure on the chipmaker after Jensen Huang's resignation.

items.title: Kalshi faces Monday hearing on New York order it says would shut down its exchange nationwide
items.summary: Kalshi, which is headquartered in New York, has said the order would shut it down nationwide, though NY's AG said that's not her goal.

items.title: Cyber investigating suspected $1 million bridge exploit as Upbit, Bithumb freeze transfers
items.summary: South Korean exchanges Upbit and Bithumb both suspended CYBER deposits and withdrawals, citing a suspected security incident.

items.title: Chainflip's FLIP drops 34% after attacker drains $4.86 million from vault with suspected key compromise
items.summary: Chainflip's FLIP token dropped 34% in price in the wake of the apparently automated attack, per The Block's price data.

items.title: JPMorgan says bitcoin's price drop pressures miners, Senate passes 'Death Bets Act', and more
items.summary: In today's newsletter, JPMorgan says bitcoin's price drop puts more pressure on miners; Senate passes bill to ban prediction markets tied to death and war; and more.

items.title: DCG's Zcash miner Fortitude clears vote for Nasdaq listing as ZEC retreats from all-time high
items.summary: Fortitude wins shareholder backing for its planned Nasdaq debut as ZEC trades 55% below its record high.

items.title: Rep. Casten seeks to curb prediction market insider trading with DOJ whistleblower program
items.summary: Rep. Sean Casten, who could have a top spot in Congress next year, is clamping down on insider trading in prediction markets.

items.title: Hackers swapped a hosted DeepSeek model for 53 hours and stripped away its safety protections
items.summary: Prime Intellect says the substitute refused none of its HarmBench prompts, down from 198 of 240 with the original model.

items.title: Russia allows Bitcoin trading as sanctioned Moscow Exchange prepares December launch
items.summary: From Nov. 22, Russian exchanges can begin trading Bitcoin once the central bank approves the rules, but customers still can't use it to pay for anything.

items.title: Aave's $4 billion USDC borrow cap could leave just $190 million available for withdrawals
items.summary: If loans fill the new cap at late Nov. 20 supply levels, about 190 million USDC would remain for withdrawals.

items.title: Singapore wants to test stablecoin payments by AI agents
items.summary: A planned sandbox would test how banks and payment providers verify an agent's authority before executing payments in digital money.

items.title: A Bitcoin drop toward $53,000 could put $240 million in collateral at risk
items.summary: An Aave borrower had nearly 90 WBTC seized Saturday, and a later snapshot shows where other loans could come under pressure.

items.title: One Bitcoin miner paid an $11.9M tariff bill four years after delivery
items.summary: Bitcoin miner Bitfarms thought the machines it brought into Washington state in 2021 had been made in Malaysia. Four years later, the company paid the government $11.9 million.

items.title: Tracy Schuchart: Bitcoin Trading "Like a Risk Asset" as Fed Hikes Loom
items.summary: Tracy Shuchart says Bitcoin's biggest long-term argument is its monetary scarcity, but investors need to separate the long-term thesis from how it's trading today.

items.title: Bitcoin Price Slips to Lows Not Seen Since 2024, Nasdaq Plunges 5%
items.summary: The bitcoin price slipped to near $58,300 on Friday afternoon, briefly dipping under its summer low, as a chip-led selloff sent the Nasdaq down about 5%.

items.title: MSTR Head of Investor Relations Addresses Bitcoin Pullback, Equity Performance
items.summary: Discussion on Bitcoin pullback and equity performance for MSTR.

items.title: Bitcoin Magazine Daily Brief
items.summary: Daily Bitcoin news and insights.

items.title: Bitcoin Adoption Continues Globally
items.summary: Ongoing developments in Bitcoin adoption.

items.title: Regulatory Updates on Bitcoin
items.summary: Latest regulatory news affecting Bitcoin.

items.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $60,000 after $1.8 billion crypto liquidation wave
items.summary: The selloff wiped out $1.8 billion in leveraged crypto positions, mostly from bullish bets on rising prices.

items.title: Cross-chain protocol Chainflip's FLIP tanks 30% after suspected $4.86 million vault drain
items.summary: The withdrawal carried a valid signature, which Onchain Lens said points to a possible compromise of the key validators use to approve vault payouts.

items.title: Ether treasury firm BTCS warns SEC its $54 million Aave loan could be liquidated
items.summary: BTCS cut its reported Aave debt by about $10 million in ten days, but falling ether prices are keeping its collateral under pressure.

items.title: Bitcoin nodes could be stalled by repeating one ID 50,000 times. AI found the bug
items.summary: Bitcoin Core shipped fixes on Friday for a bug flagged by Loupe, an open-source scanner from Block's Spiral that uses AI agents to examine bitcoin code.

items.title: XRP falls 10% as long bets unwind and ETF assets slip below $1 billion
items.summary: The token broke its previous November lows during Saturday's crypto selloff, with long positions accounting for most XRP liquidations and technical indicators showing further weakness.

items.title: Bitcoin tanks below $57,000 for the first time in two years, and its not alone
items.summary: BTC's sell-off deepened on Saturday, with prices hitting two-year lows under $57,000.
